name: My Girl Loves Handcuffs
source:
After escaping her crazed, cult-following parents, your girl begins sleepwalking—stomping through your tiny apartment and waking you every night. Desperate for rest, the two of you buy a pair of handcuffs to keep her in bed. But to both your surprise, they bring far more than just peaceful nights. What follows is a lust-driven descent into your wildest fantasies.

A guy. A girl. A pair of handcuffs. And a lot of kinky sex.

[From [url=https://395games.itch.io/my-girl-loves-handcuffs]Itch.io[/url]]

逃离信奉邪教的疯狂父母后，你的女友开始频繁梦游——每晚都会在你狭小的公寓里重重踱步，把你吵醒。急需睡个安稳觉的你们买来一副手铐，好把她固定在床上。可令你们双双意想不到的是，这副手铐带来的远不止宁静的夜晚——一场受情欲驱使、直抵你们最狂野幻想深处的沉沦之旅就此展开。
